title: KYC verification
goal: Verify borrower identity before loan disbursal

steps.name: collect-documents
steps.how: Collect PAN and Aadhaar images via borrower upload link

_expect_error: status enum violation: 'approved' is not one of proposed|registered|superseded|retired

title: EMI reconciliation
goal: Match EMI debits against the loan repayment schedule

steps.name: match-debits
steps.how: Join debits to schedule on loan_id and amount within tolerance

_expect_error: conditional violation: status=registered requires approved_by non-null (approved_by is nullable only until approve)
